description: This file defines the StateDStream class in Apache Spark Streaming, implementing stateful stream processing with methods for computing state RDDs based on previous states and parent data streams.

classes.name: StateDStream
classes.description: A stateful DStream class that maintains and updates state across streaming batches using user-defined update functions.

methods.name: computeUsingPreviousRDD
methods.description: Computes the state RDD using the previous state RDD and parent RDD, applying the update function on cogrouped data.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Main method to compute the current state RDD based on the current batch time, previous state, and parent RDDs.
